parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf made of plywood, part of the internal structure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a flat surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: Another internal shelf made of plywood, positioned at a different height.
parts.Functional_description: Supports stored items and divides the cabinet space vertically.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A third internal shelf made of plywood, forming part of the cabinet’s storage structure.
parts.Functional_description: Holds items and maintains the cabinet’s internal organization.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A front-facing cabinet door made of MDF with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: Allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates or swings open and closed around hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural integrity and supports all other parts of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed and stationary, does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The bottom base panel of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the weight of the cabinet and provides stability.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed and stationary, does not move during use.
